3 Spiritual Stones found in Hyrule... Dodongo's Cavern... Jabu-Jabu's Belly... Deku Tree... Ye who may become a Hero...

ToT Altar as Adult.message: An awakening voice from the Sacred Realm will call those destined to be Sages, who dwell in the five temples. Link's Pocket... Forest Temple... Spirit Temple... Shadow Temple... Fire Temple... Water Temple... The awakened ones require the Shadow and Spirit Medallions as well as the Light Arrows. And the evil one's key will be kept in a big chest inside its tower. Together with the Hero of Time, the awakened ones will return the light of peace to the world...
